credit: Measured from Florian Hoeller's (Flo, @flohoeller / @growthflo, Vienna) public sites affectui.com and adfects.com with Playwright getComputedStyle, document.getAnimations() and the sites' own served CSS/JS. Study material only: do not ship his assets, copy or components; reproduce the grammar.
about: Two registers from one designer. affectUI = component-library product site (neutral greys, Inter 500, dark gradient pill, gray-tray-around-white-card anatomy, calm 140-520ms motion). adfects = studio site (one accent blue #0171E3, flat pills, 6px shell around an inset panel, curved 3D reference reel). Values are computed px at 1440x900 unless noted. See knowledge/web/flohoeller-craft.md.

fonts.family: Inter (self-hosted woff2, latin + latin-ext subsets); flohoeller.com uses -apple-system / SF Pro Text

weights_used.rule: 500 for every heading, label, button and tab; 400 for body; 600 only inside product UI titles (18px card titles, 16px form headings)

fonts.text_wrap: h1 / section leads / short copy: balance; running copy: pretty

section_h2.note: always two short lines with a comma break: '81+ pieces, / none of them generic'
ends with a full stop: 'Case studies.' 'Pricing.' 'Questions.'

affectui_component_palette.note: Identical across 12 component token blocks (.ui-ans, .ui-cbx, .ui-otp, .ui-sf, .ui-dz, .ui-drp, .ui-cm, .ui-ts, .ui-seg ...). Each component exposes these as --ui-<x>-* so a host can theme it.

adfects.rule: One blue for the whole page: booking button, funding labels, pricing accents, every focus ring.

radii.concentric_rule: inner = outer - inset. Card 14 - 6 = stage 8. AI Answer tray 20 - 4 = card 16. Writing Assistant 32 - 8 = panel 24. adfects case/plan shell 14 - 6 = panel 8. Segmented control r 11 - pad 3 = pill 8.

shadows.rule: Edges are rings (0 0 0 1px or inset 1px at 5.5-8% ink), not borders; elevation is a 1-2px contact shadow plus at most one wide soft blur with negative spread.

affectui_primary_dark_pill.css: border-radius:999px; border:1px solid #0000; background: linear-gradient(#323137,#201e25) padding-box, linear-gradient(#4b4951,#31303a,#18171b) border-box; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #0d0d0d, 0 2px 4px #0000001a; color:#fafafa; font:500 14px/1 Inter; height:42px; padding:0 20px; transition: background-color .18s ease, color .18s ease, transform .18s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
affectui_primary_dark_pill.dark_mode: inverts to a light pill: linear-gradient(#f4f4f5,#e4e4e7) fill, edge #fff -> #f0f0f2 -> #d4d4d8, ring #0009, text #121213
affectui_primary_dark_pill.anatomy: three layers: (1) 2-stop vertical fill on padding-box, (2) 3-stop vertical edge gradient on border-box through a transparent 1px border = lit top edge, (3) 1px near-black outer ring + 2px/4px 10% drop

affectui_secondary_pill.css: border-radius:999px; border:0; background:#0000000a; color:#0a0a0a; font:500 13-14px Inter; height:28|36|42px;

affectui_pro_button.after: linear-gradient(105deg,#0000 30%,#ffffffbf 48% 52%,#0000 70%) translated -120% -> 120% over .9s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) on hover (one shimmer sweep)

buttons.affectui_press: every .btn:active scale(.97); primary scale(.99); icon buttons scale(.94)

adfects_accent_pill.css: border-radius:999px; border:1px solid transparent; background:#0171e3; color:#fff; font:500 14px/1 Inter; padding:10px 18px (nav, h36) | 12px 22px (hero, h40); box-shadow:none; transition: background .15s ease, color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
adfects_accent_pill.rule: only the call booking wears the accent; flat, no shadow, hover is one step down in the same blue

adfects_ink_pill.note: transparent border keeps it the same size as outlined pills beside it

buttons.vibecoded_antipattern_he_shows: rgb(37,99,235) fill, 6px radius, font-weight 600, 13px, h30 - the 'before' state in his Same-screen compare

chips.category_chip: position:absolute; top:10.5px; left:10.5px; height:22px; padding:0 8px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--card); color:#737373; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #0a0a0a1a; font:500 11px Inter;
chips.pro_chip: position:absolute; top:10.5px; right:10.5px; height:22px; padding:0 9px 0 7px; gap:3px; border-radius:999px; background:#fdf2f8; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb,#dd0674 16%,transparent), 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb,#dd0674 14%,transparent); label: linear-gradient(90deg,#dd0674,#5e3ee0) background-clip:text; bolt icon #dd0674
chips.new_chip: padding:0 7px; line-height:18px; border-radius:999px; background:#0000000a; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #0a0a0a1a; font:500 11px; color:#737373
chips.citation_chip: height:20px; padding:0 7px; border-radius:6px; background:#f4f4f5; color:#8f8f8f; font:500 11.5px
chips.adfects_funding_label: accent text #0171e3 on #f0f6fd, top-right of a 158x100 white client card, radius 14

component_tray.note: a grey tray frames the white card on every side; secondary actions live on the tray strip (Connect apps, Demo code)

adfects_plan.foot: figure + button on one baseline on the shell itself

adfects_case.shell: radius 14, padding 6, bg #fafafa, border .75px solid rgba(23,23,23,.06)
adfects_case.board: padding 2.5cqw, gap 1.25cqw, rows split 1700:550 then mirrored, tile radius 1cqw

adfects.seam_rule: seams between sections are measured and equalised (264 above About = services-to-case distance; gap below cards = gap above title)

easing.colour_changes: ease (268 uses in component CSS) - colour/bg/shadow transitions use plain ease, movement uses the ease-out curve

keyframes.lp-rise (hero copy): from { opacity:0; filter:blur(4px); transform:translateY(10px) } 700ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both, delays 0/60/120ms
keyframes.ui-ans-card (source card): from { opacity:0; transform: translateY(6px) scale(.96) } 460ms, delay 40ms steps
keyframes.ui-otp-pop (digit): from { opacity:0; transform: translateY(4px) scale(.7); filter:blur(3px) } - 'a small lift out of a blur, no bounce'
keyframes.shimmer (working label): background-position 100% -> 0% over 1.6s linear infinite, dark band rgba(23,23,23,.9) on a copy of the label
keyframes.adfects anim-word: opacity 0, translateY(8px), blur(6px) -> none, 450ms ease-out, per-word delay 30ms; filter dropped after 1600ms to free layers

ambient_loops.adfects_service_drawings: one shared 8s loop, staggered a beat apart

motion.reduced_motion: every component + hero has @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { animation:none; transition:none } (13 blocks in component CSS); keep state changes, remove movement

focus.adfects: browser default auto ring, accent #0171e3 per CSS comment

affectui_depth_of_field_collage.plane: absolute layer spanning the viewport, 7-column grid of 400x250 pre-rendered component tiles (light and dark PNG sets), every 2nd tile translate(0,60px)
affectui_depth_of_field_collage.transform: transform-origin:0 0; top:-24%; left:-6%; transform: perspective(4000px) rotateX(34deg) rotate(-16deg) scale(.78)
affectui_depth_of_field_collage.mask_outer: mask-image: radial-gradient(40% 54% at 50% 56%, #0000 42%, #00000040 72%, #000 100%), linear-gradient(#0000 0, #000 56px calc(100% - 150px), #0000 100%); mask-composite:intersect  -> empty clearing behind the copy, fades top and bottom
affectui_depth_of_field_collage.effect: tiles are sharp at the corners and go soft (2px then 8px) toward the headline, invisible under it: a lens depth of field that frames the copy
affectui_depth_of_field_collage.enter: lp-iso-in opacity 0 -> 1 over 1.4s ease-out-expo; copy rises 700ms with 60ms stagger
affectui_depth_of_field_collage.mobile: <=860px: becomes a 320px (260px at <=760) band above the copy, plane left -45%, blur layers removed

adfects_curved_reel.track: flex row, gap 22px, images height 320px width auto, radius 8, no plate, no stroke
adfects_curved_reel.per_card_transform: translateX(spacing correction) perspective(1100px) rotateY(+-k*30deg) scale(1 + k*0.26), k = min(t*t, 1.3) where t = distance from screen centre in screen-halves, eased to 0 beyond 1.5
adfects_curved_reel.z_order: zIndex = round(k*100) so outer, nearer cards sit on top
adfects_curved_reel.speed: 80 px/s at rest; draggable with throw (max 4200 px/s), settles back with exp(-2.2*dt)
adfects_curved_reel.spacing: edges of every projected card are computed so the rendered gap stays exactly 22px
adfects_curved_reel.content: dark product UI on near-black, light UI on #fafafa, and translucent glass panels over cinematic photo (grass at golden hour)
adfects_curved_reel.below: logo ticker 46 px/s, grayscale(1) opacity .45, edge mask linear-gradient 100px fades
